subject: Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile object with 6.0

messages.author: 67dd8164f9bfa181
messages.subject: Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile object with 6.0
parts:
Hendrik (and others!),

I have a stable + successful setup for aroma.affymetrix and 500k
arrays. However, when trying to get 6.0 to work, the CDF file is not
recognized:

=================================================================
>arrayHome <- c("/Users/pgweb/Sites/Aroma")
>arraySet <- c("Condensate")
>chipType <- c("GenomeWideSNP_6")
>library("aroma.affymetrix")
>library("geneplotter")
>library("EBImage")
>setwd(arrayHome)
>cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(arraySet, chipType=chipType)
Error in list("AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(arraySet, chipType =
chipType)" = <environment>, :

[2008-07-04 14:26:28] Exception: Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile
object. No annotation chip type file with that chip type found:
GenomeWideSNP_6
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Could not create ", class(static)[1], " object. No
annotation ch
at throw("Could not create ", class(static)[1], " object. No
annotation chip type
at method(static, ...)
at AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType(chipType)
at fromFiles.AffymetrixCelSet(static, path = path, cdf = cdf, ...)
at fromFiles(static, path = path, cdf = cdf, ...)
at withCallingHandlers(expr, warning = function(w)
invokeRestart("muffleWarning"))
at suppressWarnings({
at byName.AffymetrixCelSet(static, ...)
at byName(static, ...)
at method(static, ...)
at AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(arraySet, chipType = chipType)
=================================================================

The GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf is in the correct path, and is recognized
by running

=================================================================
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6", tags="Full")
print(cdf)
AffymetrixCdfFile:
Path: annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6
Filename: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf
Filesize: 470.44MB
Chip type: GenomeWideSNP_6,Full
RAM: 0.00MB
File format: v4 (binary; XDA)
Dimension: 2572x2680
Number of cells: 6892960
Number of units: 1881415
Cells per unit: 3.66
Number of QC units: 4
=================================================================

There is an error too when running

=================================================================
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromFiles("/Users/pgweb/Sites/Aroma/rawData/
Condensate/GenomeWideSNP_6/")
Error in list("AffymetrixCelSet$fromFiles("/Users/pgweb/Sites/Aroma/
rawData/Condensate/GenomeW" = <environment>, :

[2008-07-04 14:40:29] Exception: Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile
object. No annotation chip type file with that chip type found:
GenomeWideSNP_6
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Could not create ", class(static)[1], " object. No
annotation ch
at throw("Could not create ", class(static)[1], " object. No
annotation chip type
at method(static, ...)
at AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType(chipType)
at method(static, ...)
at AffymetrixCelSet$fromFiles("/Users/pgweb/Sites/Aroma/rawData/
Condensate/GenomeW
=================================================================

What could that be? The file seems to be placed correctly

/Users/pgweb/Sites/Aroma/annotationData/chipTypes/GenomeWideSNP_6/
GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf

and seems to be intact.

Mac OS X 10.5.3, R 2.7.1, aroma.affymetrix 0.9.3

Thanks for help,

Michael.

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile object with 6.0
parts:
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(arraySet, cdf=cdf)

?  Your current code is not working because you are setting chipType <- "GenomeWideSNP_6", but there is no CDF file called "GenomeWideSNP_6.cdf" in the search path, only the one with ",Full" in the name.

Cheers,

Ken

messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile object with 6.0
parts:
Hi Michael,

It is preferable not to change the filename - the ",Full" is in there for a reason (to distinguish from other cdfs for the same chip).  I would suggest it is safer to first define the cdf as in my example, and proceed from there.  Please see the SNP 6.0 vignette here:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/total-copy-number-analysis-6-0

Cheers,

Ken

Ken,

thanks; the way to use the "Full" tag in the cdf definition, and then
to refer to the cdf in the CelSet definition worked out.

Now i am stuck with a segfault when drawing chromosome 1 at x64, but
this is a completely different story :-(

Michael.
